key_insight: An F₂-linear hash partitions Pauli strings so that each k-qubit channel couples any partition to at most 4^k partitions, avoiding global deduplication synchronization.
engineering_relevance: Bounded communication helps pool memory across cores and compute nodes for memory-limited quantum simulations.
method: Evolve observables as sparse sums of Pauli strings in the Heisenberg picture.
Partition strings using an F₂-linear hash function.
Apply gates through independent tasks with gate-determined, bounded partition coupling.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks of the open-source implementation report efficient scaling within and across nodes, simulations exceeding 10^11 Pauli strings, and longer accessible many-body dynamics timescales.
watch_item: The partition-coupling bound grows as 4^k, so channels acting on many qubits may increase communication costs.
